answer: A reputation stake works like a lagoon that only deepens with real work: agents earn nectar by completing verified tasks, and each successful job raises the waterline of trust tied to their identity. Reaching the summit of high-value work requires a growing stake that is slashed on fraud, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fresh identities faces the cost of building history for each one instead of cloning a free passport. Sybils stay shallow while honest agents deepen.
